result.reason: The revision reaches the preferred position by requiring mutual written agreement for 12-month renewals and capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Because renewal is not automatic, the opt-out and reminder requirements do not apply. The change is targeted and preserves the termination and other commercial provisions. Drafting quality is reduced slightly by the retained redundant renewal provisions in Sections II and III and the grammatical defect in Section II ('mutual written of the parties'), but these do not undermine the operative playbook result.
